section_summary: The section opens with a five-page list of papers on Japan’s economic affairs and an internal note assessing a report from the Tokyo embassy. The embassy’s despatch introduces the Commercial Attaché’s extensive account of Japanese economic and financial developments from December 1941 to June 1942. The account covers wartime finance, prices, agriculture, industry, shipping, resource controls and plans for occupied territories; it continues beyond page 71.

subfiles.title: List of papers: Economic Affairs—Japan
subfiles.about: Indexes documents concerning Japan’s economy, including broadcasts, intelligence reports and wartime production.
subfiles.summary: Five-page file index listing document numbers, dates, sources and subjects.

subfiles.title: Division of Far Eastern Affairs note on Tokyo economic report
subfiles.about: Assesses the Commercial Attaché’s report and proposes filing its subjects separately.
subfiles.summary: Calls the report excellent and proposes subject-specific memoranda for filing.

subfiles.title: Notes on Economic and Financial Developments by the Commercial Attaché
subfiles.about: Transmits a report on Japanese economic and financial developments from December 8, 1941, to June 1, 1942.
subfiles.summary: Covering despatch submits the Commercial Attaché’s report, drawn largely from Japanese and English-language newspapers.

subfiles.title: Economic and Financial Notes Compiled from December 8, 1941
subfiles.about: Surveys Japan’s wartime economy and financial policy through June 1, 1942.
subfiles.summary: Pages 8–10 provide a contents list, followed by detailed notes on budgets, taxation, banking, debt, securities, prices, wages, agriculture, industry, trade and shipping. The report describes tighter state control and Japanese plans to draw resources from occupied territories through new financial and administrative institutions. It includes figures from government announcements and press reports, with commentary on shortages and production goals. The report continues beyond page 71.
